storyCards.headline: Radio Free Europe: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
R.e.m's "Radio Free Europe" reached #78 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Radio Free Europe" is the debut single by American alternative rock band R.

The song peaked at #78 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 5 weeks on the chart.

Radio Free Europe was released in 1983.

Artist: REM · Title: Radio Free Europe · Album: R.E.M.
